messages.author: Jaime Rubio Martinez
messages.body:

Can I run Amber20 in this GPU ?
is there any  benchmark ?
Thanks in advance,
Jaime

messages.author: Ross Walker
messages.body:
Hi Jaime,
Yes you can although the caveat is that, as far as I know, it has not been tested yet. I don't see any reason why it shouldn't work though. Performance wise expect somewhere between the 3080 and 3090.
https://www.exxactcorp.com/blog/Molecular-Dynamics/rtx3090-benchmarks-for-hpc-amber-a100-vs-rtx3080-vs-2080ti-vs-rtx6000
<
https://www.exxactcorp.com/blog/Molecular-Dynamics/rtx3090-benchmarks-for-hpc-amber-a100-vs-rtx3080-vs-2080ti-vs-rtx6000
>
That is assuming that NVIDIA have not baulked their limiting of Crypto mining in some way that also takes down 'science performance' at the same time.
All the best
Ross
